_about: Made-up direct premiums written by state and line for tests/web/combopie.test.cjs, in $M (the test multiplies by a million), added to combomap_state_lines.json for 2025. Keyed by NAIC code, then year: a list of [state, line, value]. Nevada has eight target lines (six named slices, then two in Other) and our company with one line above zero, one at zero and one below. No real company, code or figure.
